user.title: Yeelight Night Mode
user.description: This creates an entity for every Yeelight light that supports moonlight/night mode. Choose which kind of entity to create - you can change this later in the integration's Options.

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Yeelight Night Mode
init.description: Choose whether the night-mode entity for each bulb should be a switch or a light. Changing this reloads the integration and recreates the entities.
